items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:12:1
items.html: There is a Behina in them that joins with the Taamim de MA. This is because the Eser Sefirot de Nekudim came out in five Partzufim GAS MB. Hence, there is also TNTO in them, where each Behina connects in its opposite Behina in the TNTO of the new MA, though there are some changes in them that will be explained below.
